source_text: XI. Nam cum Montanus cum Iuliano habuisset sermones aliquos ob eam mulierem quae ad nostram communionem obrepsit, quae non communicabat, cumque post correptionem quam in eum congesserat in frigore ipso discordiae mansisset, ostensum est eadem nocte Montano hoc. Visum est, inquit, mihi venisse ad nos centuriones. cumque deducerent nos per viam longam, pervenimus in campum immensum, in quo nobis occurrerunt Cyprianus et Leucius. pervenimus autem in locum candidum, et facta sunt vestimenta nostra candida et caro nostra commutata candidior vestimentis nostris candidis. ita autem perlucida fuit caro nostra, ut oculorum visum ad intima cordis admitteret. respiciens in pectus meum video quasdam sordes, et experrectus sum in visione. et occurrit mihi Lucianus, et retuli illi visionem, et aio illi: Scis quia sordes illae illud est quod non statim concordavi cum Iuliano? et in hoc experrectus sum. qua de re, fratres dilectissimi, concordiam, pacem, unanimitatem omni virtute teneamus. imitemur iam hic esse quod ibi futuri sumus. si nos invitant iustis promissa praemia, si terret iniustis poena praedicta, si cum Christo esse et regnare cupimus, quae ad Christum et ad regnum ducant, illa faciamus. optamus vos bene valere.
thought_title: Montanus sees a stain in a white vision and urges unity
orientation: The imprisoned co-authors report Montanus's night vision after his quarrel with Julian to press their appeal to hold unity, peace, and unanimity.
pass_a_gloss: For when Montanus had had some conversations with Julian on account of that woman who had crept into our communion, who was not communicating, and when after the rebuke which he had heaped against him he had remained in that very cold of discord, this was shown to Montanus on the same night. It seemed to me, he says, that centurions came to us. And when they were leading us down through a long road, we arrived at an immense plain, in which Cyprian and Leucius met us. But we arrived at a white place, and our garments were made white and our flesh was changed whiter than our white garments. And our flesh was so translucent that it admitted the gaze of the eyes to the inner parts of the heart. Looking at my breast I see certain stains, and I awoke in the vision. And Lucian met me, and I reported the vision to him, and I say to him: Do you know that those stains are this, that I did not immediately come to unity with Julian? And at this I awoke. For which reason, most beloved brothers, let us hold unity, peace, unanimity with all strength. Let us imitate here already to be what we shall be there. If the promised rewards for the righteous invite us, if the foretold punishment for the unrighteous terrifies us, if we desire to be with Christ and to reign with Christ, let us do those things which lead to Christ and to the kingdom. We wish you to be well.

choices.english: come to unity with Julian / unity
choices.why: brief glossary fixes concordia as unity
keeps literal force of communico rather than deciding sacramental exclusion

choices.english: in that very cold of discord
choices.why: keeps the cold metaphor exactly as written
keeps bodily change literal without polishing to glorious

pass_b_english: Montanus had already had several conversations with Julian about the woman who had crept secretly into our communion and who was not communicating. Even after the rebuke Montanus had heaped upon him, Julian had remained in that very cold of discord. That same night this was shown to Montanus.

Montanus tells it this way: "Centurions came to us, and as they led us along a long road we reached an immense plain. There Cyprian and Leucius met us. Then we reached a shining white place. Our garments were made white, and our flesh was changed to something whiter than our white garments. Our flesh became so translucent that the eye could see into the depths of the heart. When I looked at my own breast, I saw some stains, and I woke within the vision. Then Lucian met me. I told him the vision and said to him, 'Do you know that those stains mean that I did not come to unity with Julian at once?' And at that I woke."

So, dearest brothers, let us hold unity, peace, and unanimity with all our strength. Let us already imitate here what we are to be there. If the rewards promised to the righteous invite us, if the punishment foretold for the unrighteous terrifies us, and if we desire to be with Christ and to reign with him, let us do the things that lead to Christ and to the kingdom. We wish you well.
